name: AoPS-style competition difficulty
principles: Rate problem-solving discovery and proof difficulty, not merely prerequisite sophistication.
The 1.0-10.0 scale also covers easier olympiad and first-round problems below Shortlist baselines; IMO/Shortlist positions are calibration anchors, not a lower bound.
Official problem position is a prior, not a hard constraint.
Student performance must not change global difficulty.
Use 0.5 increments and avoid false precision.
